elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 requires Termination Assistance beginning before expiration or upon termination for any reason.

elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The six-month continuation right requires 100 days’ advance notice before scheduled expiration and does not apply to termination for other reasons; the general post-termination assistance duty has no specified six-month duration.

elements.element: Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
elements.evidence: All expenses and charges for Termination Assistance are expressly computed using M&I’s then-current rates.

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: M&I must return all Customer Data within 30 days after expiration or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The data must be returned in a commonly used, machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: M&I must certify deletion following completion of any Termination Assistance, not expressly after data return; assistance could be completed before the 30-day return deadline.

elements.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.4 covers expiration and termination for any reason.

elements.element: Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
elements.evidence: No minimum 90-day assistance period is guaranteed. The six-month service continuation is conditioned on advance notice before expiration and does not cover other terminations.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: M&I must return all Customer Data in machine-readable form within 30 days after expiration or termination, constituting an export.
